rule: passes flips to true only after verifying in the running app; record the evidence (command + output or screenshot path) in progress.md

features.description: Profile form (state, course, year, category, income band, marks %, gender, disability) + 3 fictional demo personas
features.test: click each persona; the form fills; submitting starts a run

features.test: run a persona; the timeline shows the Lightning step and its queries
features.evidence: 29 Oct real runs: Scout 9 searches planned in 0.5-2 s (thinking off)

features.description: Tavily Extract pulls the full text of the top pages

features.evidence: Real runs + eval: 34/36 labelled rules, 14/15 deadlines over 3 runs, 0 invented

features.description: Checker in plain code marks each criterion tick / cross / unknown against the profile

features.description: Verifier flags deadlines from an old cycle or without a quote as 'check portal'

features.description: Passbook-ledger results UI: total ₹, closing-soon marker, rule ticks with quotes, design tokens from PLAN.md

features.description: .ics export of deadlines and document-chase reminders
